name: apple-plugin
description: Apple platforms stack provider for the SDLC marketplace (priority=300). Detects an Xcode project or workspace, or a Tuist / XcodeGen manifest, in the project root and claims both backend and frontend aspects, so it wins over swift-plugin on Apple app projects. Native iOS, iPadOS, macOS and watchOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI: Observation, SwiftData, navigation, per-platform skills, widgets and App Intents, Swift Testing / XCUITest. Adds apple-architect agent (Sonnet/medium). Reuses swift-foundation skills.
